name: JorgeCastro
author: castromind

sections.description:
JorgeCastro is a complete AI-powered SEO agent that automatically manages, optimizes, and scales your entire website’s SEO using modern techniques and Google-compliant strategies.

Instead of hiring multiple specialists, JorgeCastro handles:

  • ✅ Meta titles & descriptions
  • ✅ Product descriptions & specifications
  • ✅ Category page content
  • ✅ Blog posts & long-form articles
  • ✅ Press releases
  • ✅ YouTube ranking strategy
  • ✅ LLM & AI Overview optimization
  • ✅ Technical SEO improvements
  • ✅ AI visibility tracking (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overview)
  • ✅ Bulk content production
  • ✅ Keyword research & search trends

All automated. All optimized. All handled by AI.

🔥 What Makes JorgeCastro Different?

🤖 Full AI SEO Automation
JorgeCastro acts as your internal SEO department. It doesn’t just create content — it structures it correctly, applies internal linking, follows ranking algorithms, and adapts for both Google and modern LLM platforms like ChatGPT and Gemini.

Core SEO & Content Features

📝 Meta Titles & Descriptions

Automatically generate SEO-friendly meta titles and descriptions that follow industry standards and ranking logic.
Result: Optimized for Google + structured for AI & LLM visibility.

🛍 Product Content Generator

Create high-converting, SEO-optimized product descriptions including:
* Features
* Specifications
* Unique selling points
* Internal links
Result: Product pages that rank and convert.

🗂 Category Page Content

Generate fully optimized category texts designed to:
* Rank on Google
* Match search intent
* Be easy for LLMs to understand
* Include structured internal linking

📚 Articles & Blog Posts

Create long-form, authority-driven content built to rank.
* 10 topic suggestions per keyword
* Automatic internal linking
* Optimized structure
* Google + LLM compatible

📰 Press Releases

Generate professional press releases ready for:
* PR agencies
* Media distribution
* Direct publishing
Structured, polished, and SEO-optimized.

🎥 Rank on YouTube

Discover trending video ideas based on:
* Keyword
* Region
* Search demand
Includes ready-to-use:
* Description
* Content structure
* SEO-optimized format

⚙ LLM Optimizer

Create or rewrite content specifically optimized for:
* AI Overviews
* ChatGPT
* Gemini
* Future LLM engines
Modern SEO is no longer just Google. JorgeCastro prepares your website for AI-driven search.

📊 Castro Search – Keyword Intelligence

  • Monthly search volume
  • Related keywords
  • Trend graphs
  • Strategy insights
    Make data-driven SEO decisions automatically.

💎 Bulk Castro (Premium)

Scale your content production instantly.
* Generate 10–20 articles at once
* Create complete landing page sets
* Build topic clusters
* Full SEO optimization applied automatically
Perfect for agencies and growing brands.

🔧 Technical SEO Improvements

JorgeCastro doesn’t stop at content. It also:
* Identifies technical weaknesses
* Helps correct structural SEO issues
* Improves internal linking logic
* Aligns content with modern ranking factors

🎯 The Result?
JorgeCastro becomes your:
* AI SEO Strategist
* Content Writer
* Technical SEO Assistant
* AI Visibility Tracker
* Keyword Research Tool
* PR Assistant
* YouTube Strategist
All inside one WordPress plugin.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “JorgeCastro”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to Settings → JorgeCastro.
  5. Paste your API Key from your JorgeCastro dashboard and click Connect.
  6. That’s it — JorgeCastro will start handling SEO tasks automatically in the background.
sections.faq:
How do I get an API key?

Login to your JorgeCastro dashboard, navigate to Settings → API Keys, and generate a new API key.

Does it support WooCommerce?

Yes! JorgeCastro has deep integration with WooCommerce for product descriptions, category pages, and technical e-commerce SEO.

Is the content Google-compliant?

Absolutely. JorgeCastro follows modern E-E-A-T guidelines and uses white-hat SEO strategies to ensure long-term ranking stability.

How does the AI Overview optimization work?

Our LLM Optimizer analyzes how AI engines process data and structures your content so that it’s more likely to be cited in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Gemini.
